# oss-maintainer

> Write or review OSS READMEs, contribution guides (CONTRIBUTING.md or CONTRIBUTE.md), changelogs, and release pages, check a repository against the OSS release policy (0.0.x prototype vs 0.1.0+ requirements for npm tag releases, generated changelog with contributor credits, CI, license, English docs), or scaffold a Node.js or Rust OSS project with CI and contributor tooling.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/oss-maintainer
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/oss-maintainer
```

then run `apm install`.

This is an [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) skill — a portable
`SKILL.md` folder that works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
